data.name: Azurelight
data.passiveDescription: Within 12s after an Elemental Skill is used, ATK is increased by {{24//30//36//42//48%}}. During this time, when the equipping character has 0 Energy, ATK will be further increased by {{24//30//36//42//48%}}, and CRIT DMG will be increased by {{40/50//60//70//80%}}.
